```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Grid,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [editingRoute, setEditingRoute] = useState<CommuteRoute | null>(null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} button onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Grid,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} button onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} button onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Grid,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} button onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Button,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute } from '../services/commuteService';

const RouteDetail: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<CommuteRoute | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadRoute(parseInt(id));
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (route && map) {
      // Add markers for start and end points
      const startMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '起點',
        label: 'A',
      });

      const endMarker = new google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '終點',
        label: 'B',
      });

      // Fit map to show both markers
      const bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      map.fitBounds(bounds);

      // Get directions and display route
      if (isMapLoaded) {
        const directionsService = new google.maps.DirectionsService();
        const directionsRenderer = new google.maps.DirectionsRenderer();
        directionsRenderer.setMap(map);

        directionsService.route(
          {
            origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
            destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
            travelMode: route.transport_mode === 'driving' ? google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'walking' ? google.maps.TravelMode.WALKING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'bicycling' ? google.maps.TravelMode.BICYCLING :
                       google.maps.TravelMode.TRANSIT,
          },
          (result, status) => {
            if (status === 'OK' && result) {
              directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
            }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }, [route, map, isMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoute = async (routeId: number) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routeData = await commuteService.getRoute(routeId);
      setRoute(routeData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoute({ ...route, is_favorite: !route.is_favorite });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(route.id);
        navigate('/');
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !route) {
    return (
      <Box>
        <Alert severity="error">
          {error || '路線不存在'}
        </Alert>
        <Button
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          sx={{ mt: 2 }}
        >
          返回首頁
        </Button>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" mb={3}>
        <IconButton onClick={() => navigate('/')} sx={{ mr: 1 }}>
          <ArrowBackIcon />
        </IconButton>
        <Typography variant="h4" component="h1">
          {route.name}
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ ml: 'auto' }}>
          <IconButton onClick={handleToggleFavorite}>
            {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton onClick={handleDeleteRoute}>
            <DeleteIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線資訊
              </Typography>
              
              {route.description && (
                <Typography variant="body1" paragraph>
                  {route.description}
                </Typography>
              )}

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  起點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.start_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  終點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.end_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box display="flex" gap={1} mb={2}>
                <Chip
                  label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                  color="primary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                  color="secondary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={route.transport_mode}
                  variant="outlined"
                />
              </Box>

              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                建立時間: {new Date(route.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '400px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RouteDetail;
```

```typescriptreact
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute } from '../services/commuteService';

const RouteDetail: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { map, isMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<CommuteRoute | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadRoute(parseInt(id));
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (route && map) {
      // Add markers for start and end points
      const startMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '起點',
        label: 'A',
      });

      const endMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '終點',
        label: 'B',
      });

      // Fit map to show both markers
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      map.fitBounds(bounds);

      // Get directions and display route
      if (isMapLoaded) {
        const directionsService = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsService();
        const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer();
        directionsRenderer.setMap(map);

        directionsService.route(
          {
            origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
            destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
            travelMode: route.transport_mode === 'driving' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'walking' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.WALKING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'bicycling' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.BICYCLING :
                       (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.TRANSIT,
          },
          (result: any, status: any) => {
            if (status === 'OK' && result) {
              directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
            }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }, [route, map, isMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoute = async (routeId: number) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routeData = await commuteService.getRoute(routeId);
      setRoute(routeData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoute({ ...route, is_favorite: !route.is_favorite });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(route.id);
        navigate('/');
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !route) {
    return (
      <Box>
        <Alert severity="error">
          {error || '路線不存在'}
        </Alert>
        <Button
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          sx={{ mt: 2 }}
        >
          返回首頁
        </Button>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" mb={3}>
        <IconButton onClick={() => navigate('/')} sx={{ mr: 1 }}>
          <ArrowBackIcon />
        </IconButton>
        <Typography variant="h4" component="h1">
          {route.name}
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ ml: 'auto' }}>
          <IconButton onClick={handleToggleFavorite}>
            {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton onClick={handleDeleteRoute}>
            <DeleteIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線資訊
              </Typography>
              
              {route.description && (
                <Typography variant="body1" paragraph>
                  {route.description}
                </Typography>
              )}

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  起點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.start_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  終點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.end_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box display="flex" gap={1} mb={2}>
                <Chip
                  label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                  color="primary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                  color="secondary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={route.transport_mode}
                  variant="outlined"
                />
              </Box>

              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                建立時間: {new Date(route.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '400px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RouteDetail;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Grid,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>

        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Button,
  Grid,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  ArrowBack as ArrowBackIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute } from '../services/commuteService';

const RouteDetail: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { map, isMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<CommuteRoute | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadRoute(parseInt(id));
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (route && map) {
      // Add markers for start and end points
      const startMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '起點',
        label: 'A',
      });

      const endMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '終點',
        label: 'B',
      });

      // Fit map to show both markers
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      map.fitBounds(bounds);

      // Get directions and display route
      if (isMapLoaded) {
        const directionsService = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsService();
        const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer();
        directionsRenderer.setMap(map);

        directionsService.route(
          {
            origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
            destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
            travelMode: route.transport_mode === 'driving' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'walking' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.WALKING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'bicycling' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.BICYCLING :
                       (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.TRANSIT,
          },
          (result: any, status: any) => {
            if (status === 'OK' && result) {
              directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
            }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }, [route, map, isMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoute = async (routeId: number) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routeData = await commuteService.getRoute(routeId);
      setRoute(routeData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoute({ ...route, is_favorite: !route.is_favorite });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(route.id);
        navigate('/');
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !route) {
    return (
      <Box>
        <Alert severity="error">
          {error || '路線不存在'}
        </Alert>
        <Button
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          sx={{ mt: 2 }}
        >
          返回首頁
        </Button>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" mb={3}>
        <IconButton onClick={() => navigate('/')} sx={{ mr: 1 }}>
          <ArrowBackIcon />
        </IconButton>
        <Typography variant="h4" component="h1">
          {route.name}
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ ml: 'auto' }}>
          <IconButton onClick={handleToggleFavorite}>
            {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton onClick={handleDeleteRoute}>
            <DeleteIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線資訊
              </Typography>
              
              {route.description && (
                <Typography variant="body1" paragraph>
                  {route.description}
                </Typography>
              )}

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  起點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.start_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  終點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.end_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box display="flex" gap={1} mb={2}>
                <Chip
                  label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                  color="primary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                  color="secondary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={route.transport_mode}
                  variant="outlined"
                />
              </Box>

              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                建立時間: {new Date(route.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '400px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RouteDetail;
```

Now let me fix the MapContext type issue:


```typescriptreact
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

interface MapContextType {
  map: any | null;
  setMap: (map: any | null) => void;
  selectedLocation: { lat: number; lng: number; address: string } | null;
  setSelectedLocation: (location: { lat: number; lng: number; address: string } | null) => void;
  isMapLoaded: boolean;
  setIsMapLoaded: (loaded: boolean) => void;
}

const MapContext = createContext<MapContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const useMap = () => {
  const context = useContext(MapContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useMap must be used within a MapProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

interface MapProviderProps {
  children: ReactNode;
}

export const MapProvider: React.FC<MapProviderProps> = ({ children }) => {
  const [map, setMap] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [selectedLocation, setSelectedLocation] = useState<{ lat: number; lng: number; address: string } | null>(null);
  const [isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded] = useState(false);

  const value = {
    map,
    setMap,
    selectedLocation,
    setSelectedLocation,
    isMapLoaded,
    setIsMapLoaded
  };

  return (
    <MapContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </MapContext.Provider>
  );
};
```
