import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid2';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import Grid from '@mui/material/Grid2';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid item xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { map, isMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<CommuteRoute | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadRoute(parseInt(id));
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (route && map) {
      // Add markers for start and end points
      new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '起點',
        label: 'A',
      });

      new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '終點',
        label: 'B',
      });

      // Fit map to show both markers
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      map.fitBounds(bounds);

      // Get directions and display route
      if (isMapLoaded) {
        const directionsService = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsService();
        const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer();
        directionsRenderer.setMap(map);

        directionsService.route(
          {
            origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
            destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
            travelMode: route.transport_mode === 'driving' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'walking' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.WALKING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'bicycling' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.BICYCLING :
                       (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.TRANSIT,
          },
          (result: any, status: any) => {
            if (status === 'OK' && result) {
              directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
            }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }, [route, map, isMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoute = async (routeId: number) => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routeData = await commuteService.getRoute(routeId);
      setRoute(routeData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoute({ ...route, is_favorite: !route.is_favorite });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async () => {
    if (!route) return;
    
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(route.id);
        navigate('/');
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  if (error || !route) {
    return (
      <Box>
        <Alert severity="error">
          {error || '路線不存在'}
        </Alert>
        <Button
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          sx={{ mt: 2 }}
        >
          返回首頁
        </Button>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Box display="flex" alignItems="center" mb={3}>
        <IconButton onClick={() => navigate('/')} sx={{ mr: 1 }}>
          <ArrowBackIcon />
        </IconButton>
        <Typography variant="h4" component="h1">
          {route.name}
        </Typography>
        <Box sx={{ ml: 'auto' }}>
          <IconButton onClick={handleToggleFavorite}>
            {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
          </IconButton>
          <IconButton onClick={handleDeleteRoute}>
            <DeleteIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線資訊
              </Typography>
              
              {route.description && (
                <Typography variant="body1" paragraph>
                  {route.description}
                </Typography>
              )}

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  起點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.start_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  終點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.end_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box display="flex" gap={1} mb={2}>
                <Chip
                  label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                  color="primary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                  color="secondary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={route.transport_mode}
                  variant="outlined"
                />
              </Box>

              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">
                建立時間: {new Date(route.created_at).toLocaleString('zh-TW')}
              </Typography>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        <Grid item xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '400px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default RouteDetail;

Now let me try building the frontend again:


It seems Grid2 is not available in this version. Let me use a different approach with Box components instead:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={4}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>

        {/* Map */}
        <Grid xs={12} md={8}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Grid>
      </Grid>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Typography,
  Card,
  CardContent,

  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
  IconButton,
} from '@mui/material';

  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute } from '../services/commuteService';

const RouteDetail: React.FC = () => {
  const { id } = useParams<{ id: string }>();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { map, isMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [route, setRoute] = useState<CommuteRoute | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      loadRoute(parseInt(id));
    }
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {

      new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '起點',
        label: 'A',
      });

      new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: '終點',
        label: 'B',
      });

      // Fit map to show both markers
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      map.fitBounds(bounds);

      // Get directions and display route
      if (isMapLoaded) {

        const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer();
        directionsRenderer.setMap(map);

        directionsService.route(
          {
            origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
            destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
            travelMode: route.transport_mode === 'driving' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'walking' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.WALKING :
                       route.transport_mode === 'bicycling' ? (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.BICYCLING :
                       (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.TRANSIT,
          },

              directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
            }
          }
        );
      }
    }
  }, [route, map, isMapLoaded]);

      setRoute(routeData);

      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async () => {

    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoute({ ...route, is_favorite: !route.is_favorite });
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async () => {

    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {

        navigate('/');
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {

  if (loading) {

    );
  }

  if (error || !route) {
    return (
      <Box>
        <Alert severity="error">

        </Alert>
        <Button
          startIcon={<ArrowBackIcon />}
          onClick={() => navigate('/')}
          sx={{ mt: 2 }}
        >
          返回首頁
        </Button>
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>

          </IconButton>
          <IconButton onClick={handleDeleteRoute}>
            <DeleteIcon />
          </IconButton>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Grid container spacing={3}>
        <Grid xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                路線資訊
              </Typography>
              
              {route.description && (
                <Typography variant="body1" paragraph>
                  {route.description}
                </Typography>
              )}

              <Box mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="subtitle2" color="text.secondary">
                  起點
                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.start_address}
                </Typography>

              <Box mb={2}>

                </Typography>
                <Typography variant="body1">
                  {route.end_address}
                </Typography>
              </Box>

              <Box display="flex" gap={1} mb={2}>
                <Chip
                  label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                  color="primary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                  color="secondary"
                  variant="outlined"
                />
                <Chip
                  label={route.transport_mode}
                  variant="outlined"
                />
              </Box>

              <Typography variant="caption" color="text.secondary">

              </Typography>
            </CardContent>

        <Grid xs={12} md={6}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>

      </Grid>
    </Box>

};

export default RouteDetail;

```typescriptreact
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ThemeProvider, createTheme } from '@mui/material/styles';
import CssBaseline from '@mui/material/CssBaseline';
import { AuthProvider } from './contexts/AuthContext';
import { MapProvider } from './contexts/MapContext';
import Login from './pages/Login';
import Register from './pages/Register';
import Dashboard from './pages/Dashboard';
import RouteDetail from './pages/RouteDetail';
import ProtectedRoute from './components/ProtectedRoute';
import Layout from './components/Layout';

const theme = createTheme({
  palette: {
    primary: {
      main: '#1976d2',
    },
    secondary: {
      main: '#dc004e',
    },
  },
  typography: {
    fontFamily: '"Roboto", "Helvetica", "Arial", sans-serif',
  },
});

function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme={theme}>
      <CssBaseline />
      <AuthProvider>
        <MapProvider>
          <Router>
            <Routes>
              <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
              <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />
              <Route
                path="/"
                element={
                  <ProtectedRoute>
                    <Layout>
                      <Dashboard />
                    </Layout>
                  </ProtectedRoute>
                }
              />
              <Route
                path="/route/:id"
                element={
                  <ProtectedRoute>
                    <Layout>
                      <RouteDetail />
                    </Layout>
                  </ProtectedRoute>
                }
              />
              <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
            </Routes>
          </Router>
        </MapProvider>
      </AuthProvider>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

export default App;
```

```markdown
# 通勤地圖 (Commute Map) - HW#4

一個基於 Google Maps 的全端通勤路線管理應用程式，幫助使用者追蹤和管理日常通勤路線、交通選項和旅行時間。

## 專案簡介

通勤地圖是一個現代化的全端 Web 應用程式，採用前後端分離架構，整合 Google Maps API 提供豐富的地圖功能。使用者可以：

- 建立和管理個人通勤路線
- 查看路線的詳細資訊（距離、時間、交通方式）
- 在地圖上視覺化路線
- 收藏常用路線
- 搜尋地點和獲取路線指引

## 功能清單

### 核心功能
- ✅ 使用者註冊/登入系統（JWT 認證）
- ✅ 通勤路線 CRUD 操作
- ✅ Google Maps 整合（地圖顯示、地點搜尋、路線規劃）
- ✅ 路線收藏功能
- ✅ 響應式設計

### 技術特色
- 前後端分離架構
- TypeScript 全端開發
- SQLite 資料庫持久化
- Google Maps JavaScript API + 伺服器端 API
- Material-UI 現代化介面
- JWT 安全認證

## 架構圖

```
┌─────────────────┐    HTTP/HTTPS    ┌─────────────────┐
│   Frontend      │ ◄──────────────► │   Backend       │
│   (React)       │                  │   (Node.js)     │
│                 │                  │                 │
│ • React Router  │                  │ • Express       │
│ • Material-UI   │                  │ • SQLite        │
│ • Google Maps   │                  │ • JWT Auth      │
│ • Axios         │                  │ • Google APIs   │
└─────────────────┘                  └─────────────────┘
         │                                    │
         │                                    │
         ▼                                    ▼
┌─────────────────┐                  ┌─────────────────┐
│  Google Maps    │                  │  Google Cloud   │
│  JavaScript API │                  │  Server APIs    │
│  (Browser Key)  │                  │  (Server Key)   │
└─────────────────┘                  └─────────────────┘
```

## 技術棧

### 前端
- **React 19** + **TypeScript**
- **Vite** (建置工具)
- **React Router** (路由管理)
- **Material-UI** (UI 框架)
- **Axios** (HTTP 客戶端)
- **Google Maps JavaScript API**

### 後端
- **Node.js** + **Express** + **TypeScript**
- **SQLite** (資料庫)
- **JWT** (身份驗證)
- **bcryptjs** (密碼雜湊)
- **Google Maps Server APIs** (Geocoding, Places, Directions)

## 安裝與設定

### 前置需求
- Node.js 18+ 
- npm 或 yarn
- Google Cloud Platform 帳號

### 1. 複製專案
```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd wp1141/hw4
```

### 2. 設定 Google Maps API

#### 建立 Google Cloud 專案
1. 前往 [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/)
2. 建立新專案（例如：`commute-map-app`）
3. 啟用以下 APIs：
   - Maps JavaScript API
   - Geocoding API
   - Places API
   - Directions API

#### 建立 API Keys
1. **Browser Key** (前端用)：
   - 限制類型：HTTP 網域
   - 允許清單：`http://localhost:[PORT]/*`, `http://127.0.0.1:[PORT]/*`
   - 啟用 API：Maps JavaScript API

2. **Server Key** (後端用)：
   - 限制類型：IP 位址（本地開發可暫時無限制）
   - 啟用 APIs：Geocoding API, Places API, Directions API

### 3. 設定環境變數

#### 前端環境變數
```bash
# frontend/.env
VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY=[MASKED_API_KEY]
VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:[PORT]
```

#### 後端環境變數
```bash
# backend/.env
PORT=3000
CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:[PORT],http://127.0.0.1:[PORT]
DATABASE_URL=[MASKED_DB_URL]
JWT_SECRET=[MASKED_SECRET]
GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY=[MASKED_API_KEY]
```

### 4. 安裝依賴並啟動

#### 後端
```bash
cd backend
npm install
npm run build
npm run dev
```

#### 前端
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### 5. 存取應用程式
- 前端：http://localhost:[PORT]
- 後端 API：http://localhost:[PORT]

## API 文件

### 認證端點

#### 註冊
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:[PORT]/auth/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "username": "testuser",
    "password": "password123"
  }'
```

#### 登入
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:[PORT]/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "password": "password123"
  }'
```

#### 取得使用者資料
```bash
curl -X GET http://localhost:[PORT]/auth/profile \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
```

### 通勤路線端點

#### 取得所有路線
```bash
curl -X GET http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
```

#### 建立新路線
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "上班路線",
    "description": "從家到公司的路線",
    "startAddress": "台北車站",
    "endAddress": "信義區",
    "transportMode": "driving"
  }'
```

#### 取得特定路線
```bash
curl -X GET http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute/1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
```

#### 更新路線
```bash
curl -X PUT http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute/1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "更新後的路線名稱",
    "isFavorite": true
  }'
```

#### 刪除路線
```bash
curl -X DELETE http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute/1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
```

### Google Maps 整合端點

#### 搜尋地點
```bash
curl -X GET "http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute/search/places?query=台北101&lat=25.0330&lng=121.5654" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
```

#### 取得路線指引
```bash
curl -X GET "http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute/directions?origin=台北車站&destination=信義區&mode=driving" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN"
```

## 資料庫結構

### Users 表
```sql
CREATE TABLE users (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
```

### Commute Routes 表
```sql
CREATE TABLE commute_routes (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  start_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  end_address TEXT NOT NULL,
  start_lat REAL NOT NULL,
  start_lng REAL NOT NULL,
  end_lat REAL NOT NULL,
  end_lng REAL NOT NULL,
  transport_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'driving',
  duration_seconds INTEGER,
  distance_meters INTEGER,
  is_favorite BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
```

**Cursor**

Perfect! The backend is working correctly for all the non-Google Maps endpoints. The error you're seeing is expected because the Google Maps API key is not set up yet. Let me explain what's happening and how to fix it.

## 錯誤分析

The error `REQUEST_DENIED` means the Google Maps API is rejecting the request because:

1. **API Key 未設定**：目前使用的是 `YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER`
2. **API 未啟用**：需要啟用 Geocoding, Places, 和 Directions APIs
3. **API Key 限制**：可能設定了不當的限制

## 解決方案

### 方法 1: 暫時禁用 Google Maps 功能進行測試

Let me modify the Google Maps service to handle missing API keys gracefully:


Let me add a check for the API key at the beginning of the service:


```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

const GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY;
const GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL = 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api';

// Check if API key is properly configured
const isApiKeyConfigured = () => {
  return GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY && 
         GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' && 
         GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER';
};

export interface GeocodingResult {
  address: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  formatted_address: string;
}

export interface DirectionsResult {
  distance: { text: string; value: number };
  duration: { text: string; value: number };
  steps: Array<{
    instruction: string;
    distance: { text: string; value: number };
    duration: { text: string; value: number };
  }>;
}

export interface PlaceResult {
  place_id: string;
  name: string;
  formatted_address: string;
  geometry: {
    location: { lat: number; lng: number };
  };
  rating?: number;
  types: string[];
}

export class GoogleMapsService {
  // Geocoding: Convert address to coordinates
  static async geocodeAddress(address: string): Promise<GeocodingResult> {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/geocode/json`, {
        params: {
          address,
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Geocoding failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const result = response.data.results[0];
      return {
        address: result.formatted_address,
        lat: result.geometry.location.lat,
        lng: result.geometry.location.lng,
        formatted_address: result.formatted_address
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Geocoding error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to geocode address');
    }
  }

  // Directions: Get route between two points
  static async getDirections(
    origin: string,
    destination: string,
    mode: string = 'driving'
  ): Promise<DirectionsResult> {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/directions/json`, {
        params: {
          origin,
          destination,
          mode,
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Directions failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const route = response.data.routes[0].legs[0];
      return {
        distance: route.distance,
        duration: route.duration,
        steps: route.steps.map((step: any) => ({
          instruction: step.html_instructions.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ''), // Remove HTML tags
          distance: step.distance,
          duration: step.duration
        }))
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Directions error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get directions');
    }
  }

  // Places: Search for places near a location
  static async searchPlaces(
    query: string,
    location?: { lat: number; lng: number },
    radius: number = 5000
  ): Promise<PlaceResult[]> {
    try {
      const params: any = {
        query,
        key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
      };

      if (location) {
        params.location = `${location.lat},${location.lng}`;
        params.radius = radius;
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/textsearch/json`, {
        params
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Places search failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      return response.data.results.map((place: any) => ({
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Places search error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to search places');
    }
  }

  // Get place details
  static async getPlaceDetails(placeId: string): Promise<PlaceResult> {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/details/json`, {
        params: {
          place_id: placeId,
          fields: 'place_id,name,formatted_address,geometry,rating,types',
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Place details failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const place = response.data.result;
      return {
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Place details error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get place details');
    }
  }
}

```

## 如何設定 Google Maps API Key

### 步驟 1: 申請 Google Cloud 專案
1. 前往 [Google Cloud Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/)
2. 建立新專案（例如：`commute-map-hw4`）

### 步驟 2: 啟用必要的 APIs
在 API 和服務 → 程式庫中啟用：
- **Geocoding API**
- **Places API** 
- **Directions API**

### 步驟 3: 建立 API Key

```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

const GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY = process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY;
const GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL = 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api';

// Check if API key is properly configured
const isApiKeyConfigured = () => {
  console.log('API Key check:', {
    hasKey: !!GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY,
    keyValue: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY ? GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'undefined',
    isPlaceholder: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY === 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' || GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY === 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER'
  });
  
  return GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY && 
         GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' && 
         GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER';
};

export interface GeocodingResult {
  address: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  formatted_address: string;
}

export interface DirectionsResult {
  distance: { text: string; value: number };
  duration: { text: string; value: number };
  steps: Array<{
    instruction: string;
    distance: { text: string; value: number };
    duration: { text: string; value: number };
  }>;
}

export interface PlaceResult {
  place_id: string;
  name: string;
  formatted_address: string;
  geometry: {
    location: { lat: number; lng: number };
  };
  rating?: number;
  types: string[];
}

export class GoogleMapsService {
  // Geocoding: Convert address to coordinates
  static async geocodeAddress(address: string): Promise<GeocodingResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/geocode/json`, {
        params: {
          address,
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Geocoding failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const result = response.data.results[0];
      return {
        address: result.formatted_address,
        lat: result.geometry.location.lat,
        lng: result.geometry.location.lng,
        formatted_address: result.formatted_address
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Geocoding error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to geocode address');
    }
  }

  // Directions: Get route between two points
  static async getDirections(
    origin: string,
    destination: string,
    mode: string = 'driving'
  ): Promise<DirectionsResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/directions/json`, {
        params: {
          origin,
          destination,
          mode,
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Directions failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const route = response.data.routes[0].legs[0];
      return {
        distance: route.distance,
        duration: route.duration,
        steps: route.steps.map((step: any) => ({
          instruction: step.html_instructions.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ''), // Remove HTML tags
          distance: step.distance,
          duration: step.duration
        }))
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Directions error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get directions');
    }
  }

  // Places: Search for places near a location
  static async searchPlaces(
    query: string,
    location?: { lat: number; lng: number },
    radius: number = 5000
  ): Promise<PlaceResult[]> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const params: any = {
        query,
        key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
      };

      if (location) {
        params.location = `${location.lat},${location.lng}`;
        params.radius = radius;
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/textsearch/json`, {
        params
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Places search failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      return response.data.results.map((place: any) => ({
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Places search error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to search places');
    }
  }

  // Get place details
  static async getPlaceDetails(placeId: string): Promise<PlaceResult> {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/details/json`, {
        params: {
          place_id: placeId,
          fields: 'place_id,name,formatted_address,geometry,rating,types',
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Place details failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const place = response.data.result;
      return {
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Place details error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get place details');
    }
  }
}

```

  origin: process.env.CORS_ORIGINS?.split(',') || ['http://localhost:[PORT]', 'http://127.0.0.1:[PORT]'],

      keyValue: process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY ? process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'undefined'
    });
    
    app.listen(PORT, () => {
      console.log(`🚀 Server running on port ${PORT}`);
      console.log(`📍 Health check: http://localhost:${PORT}/health`);
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to start server:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
};

startServer();

```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

const GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL = 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api';

// Get API key dynamically each time it's needed
const getApiKey = () => {
  return process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY;
};

// Check if API key is properly configured
const isApiKeyConfigured = () => {
  const apiKey = getApiKey();
  console.log('API Key check:', {
    hasKey: !!apiKey,
    keyValue: apiKey ? apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'undefined',
    isPlaceholder: apiKey === 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' || apiKey === 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER'
  });
  
  return apiKey && 
         apiKey !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' && 
         apiKey !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER';
};

export interface GeocodingResult {
  address: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  formatted_address: string;
}

export interface DirectionsResult {
  distance: { text: string; value: number };
  duration: { text: string; value: number };
  steps: Array<{
    instruction: string;
    distance: { text: string; value: number };
    duration: { text: string; value: number };

}

export interface PlaceResult {
  place_id: string;
  name: string;
  formatted_address: string;

  rating?: number;
  types: string[];

export class GoogleMapsService {
  // Geocoding: Convert address to coordinates
  static async geocodeAddress(address: string): Promise<GeocodingResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/geocode/json`, {
        params: {
          address,
          key: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Geocoding failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const result = response.data.results[0];
      return {
        address: result.formatted_address,
        lat: result.geometry.location.lat,
        lng: result.geometry.location.lng,
        formatted_address: result.formatted_address
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Geocoding error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to geocode address');
    }
  }

  // Directions: Get route between two points
  static async getDirections(
    origin: string,
    destination: string,
    mode: string = 'driving'
  ): Promise<DirectionsResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/details/json`, {
        params: {
          place_id: placeId,
          fields: 'place_id,name,formatted_address,geometry,rating,types',
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Place details failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const place = response.data.result;
      return {
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Place details error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get place details');
    }
  }
}

```
