Great! The Google Maps API is working now. The 404 error for `/commute/directions` is happening because there's a routing issue. Let me check the routes configuration.


The routes look correct. The issue might be with the route ordering. The `/directions` route is defined after the `/:id` route, which means Express is treating "directions" as an ID parameter. Let me check the route order:


Found the issue! The problem is route ordering. The `/:id` route (line 29) is defined before the `/directions` route (line 255), so Express is matching `/directions` as `/:id` where `id = "directions"`.

Let me fix this by moving the specific routes before the parameterized routes:


```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { db } from '../utils/database';
import { authenticateToken } from '../middleware/auth';
import { GoogleMapsService } from '../services/googleMapsService';

const router = express.Router();

// All routes require authentication
router.use(authenticateToken);

// Get all commute routes for the authenticated user
router.get('/', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;

  db.all(
    'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC',
    [userId],
    (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching commute routes:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch commute routes' });
      }
      res.json(rows);
    }
  );
});

// Search places near a location (must be before /:id route)
router.get('/search/places', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { query, lat, lng, radius = 5000 } = req.query;

    if (!query) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Query parameter is required' });
    }

    const location = lat && lng ? { lat: parseFloat(lat), lng: parseFloat(lng) } : undefined;
    const places = await GoogleMapsService.searchPlaces(
      query as string,
      location,
      parseInt(radius as string)
    );

    res.json(places);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error searching places:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to search places' });
  }
});

// Get directions between two points (must be before /:id route)
router.get('/directions', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { origin, destination, mode = 'driving' } = req.query;

    if (!origin || !destination) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Origin and destination parameters are required'
      });
    }

    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
      origin as string,
      destination as string,
      mode as string
    );

    res.json(directions);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting directions:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to get directions' });
  }
});

// Get a specific commute route
router.get('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.get(
    'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    (err, row) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch commute route' });
      }
      if (!row) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json(row);
    }
  );
});

// Create a new commute route
router.post('/', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user.id;
    const {
      name,
      description,
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode = 'driving'
    } = req.body;

    // Validation
    if (!name || !startAddress || !endAddress) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Name, start address, and end address are required'
      });
    }

    // Geocode addresses to get coordinates
    const startGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(startAddress);
    const endGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(endAddress);

    // Get directions to calculate duration and distance
    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode
    );

    // Insert into database
    const routeId = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(
        `INSERT INTO commute_routes (
          user_id, name, description, start_address, end_address,
          start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng, transport_mode,
          duration_seconds, distance_meters
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          userId, name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startGeocode.lat, startGeocode.lng, endGeocode.lat, endGeocode.lng,
          transportMode, directions.duration.value, directions.distance.value
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.lastID);
        }
      );
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      message: 'Commute route created successfully',
      route: {
        id: routeId,
        name,
        description,
        startAddress,
        endAddress,
        startLat: startGeocode.lat,
        startLng: startGeocode.lng,
        endLat: endGeocode.lat,
        endLng: endGeocode.lng,
        transportMode,
        duration: directions.duration,
        distance: directions.distance
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to create commute route' });
  }
});

// Update a commute route
router.put('/:id', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user.id;
    const routeId = req.params.id;
    const {
      name,
      description,
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode,
      isFavorite
    } = req.body;

    // Check if route exists and belongs to user
    const existingRoute = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(
        'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
        [routeId, userId],
        (err, row) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(row);
        }
      );
    });

    if (!existingRoute) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
    }

    // If addresses changed, geocode them
    let startLat: number | undefined, startLng: number | undefined, endLat: number | undefined, endLng: number | undefined, duration: number | undefined, distance: number | undefined;
    
    if (startAddress && endAddress) {
      const startGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(startAddress);
      const endGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(endAddress);
      const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
        startAddress,
        endAddress,
        transportMode || (existingRoute as any).transport_mode
      );
      
      startLat = startGeocode.lat;
      startLng = startGeocode.lng;
      endLat = endGeocode.lat;
      endLng = endGeocode.lng;
      duration = directions.duration.value;
      distance = directions.distance.value;
    }

    // Update route
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(
        `UPDATE commute_routes SET
          name = COALESCE(?, name),
          description = COALESCE(?, description),
          start_address = COALESCE(?, start_address),
          end_address = COALESCE(?, end_address),
          start_lat = COALESCE(?, start_lat),
          start_lng = COALESCE(?, start_lng),
          end_lat = COALESCE(?, end_lat),
          end_lng = COALESCE(?, end_lng),
          transport_mode = COALESCE(?, transport_mode),
          duration_seconds = COALESCE(?, duration_seconds),
          distance_meters = COALESCE(?, distance_meters),
          is_favorite = COALESCE(?, is_favorite),
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?`,
        [
          name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng,
          transportMode, duration, distance, isFavorite,
          routeId, userId
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.changes);
        }
      );
    });

    res.json({ message: 'Commute route updated successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to update commute route' });
  }
});

// Delete a commute route
router.delete('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.run(
    'DELETE FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    function(err) {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error deleting commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to delete commute route' });
      }
      if (this.changes === 0) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json({ message: 'Commute route deleted successfully' });
    }
  );
});

// Search places near a location
router.get('/search/places', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { query, lat, lng, radius = 5000 } = req.query;

    if (!query) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Query parameter is required' });
    }

    const location = lat && lng ? { lat: parseFloat(lat), lng: parseFloat(lng) } : undefined;
    const places = await GoogleMapsService.searchPlaces(
      query as string,
      location,
      parseInt(radius as string)
    );

    res.json(places);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error searching places:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to search places' });
  }
});

// Get directions between two points
router.get('/directions', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { origin, destination, mode = 'driving' } = req.query;

    if (!origin || !destination) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Origin and destination parameters are required'
      });
    }

    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(

    );

    res.json(directions);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting directions:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to get directions' });
  }
});

export { router as commuteRoutes };
```

2. **測試 Directions 端點**:

   ```bash
   curl -X GET "http://localhost:[PORT]/api/commute/directions?origin=台北車站&destination=信義區&mode=driving" \

   ```

## 問題解決

**原因**: Express.js 路由匹配是順序性的。當 `/directions` 路由定義在 `/:id` 路由之後時，Express 會將 "directions" 當作 ID 參數來處理。

**解決方案**: 將具體的路由（如 `/search/places` 和 `/directions`）移到參數化路由（如 `/:id`）之前。

- `GET /api/commute/:id` - 取得特定路線
- `PUT /api/commute/:id` - 更新路線
- `DELETE /api/commute/:id` - 刪除路線
- `GET /api/commute/search/places` - 搜尋地點
- `GET /api/commute/directions` - 取得路線指引

### 3. 檢查環境變數是否正確載入

讓我添加一些調試信息來檢查環境變數：


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
      const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
      googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
      googleMapsScript.async = true;
      googleMapsScript.defer = true;
      
      googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
        console.log('Google Maps script loaded successfully');
        try {
          const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
            center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
            zoom: 12,
          });
          
          console.log('Google Maps instance created:', !!mapInstance);
          setMap(mapInstance);
          setIsMapLoaded(true);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
        }
      };
      
      googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
        console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
      };
      
      document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    }
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

```

**Cursor**

I see the issue! The problem is that `Map ref current: false` - the map reference is not available when the useEffect runs. This means the DOM element isn't ready yet when we try to initialize the map.

Let me fix this by adding a small delay and ensuring the ref is properly set:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    const initializeMap = () => {
      if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
        console.log('Initializing Google Maps...');
        const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
        googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
        googleMapsScript.async = true;
        googleMapsScript.defer = true;
        
        googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
          console.log('Google Maps script loaded successfully');
          try {
            const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
              center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
              zoom: 12,
            });
            
            console.log('Google Maps instance created:', !!mapInstance);
            setMap(mapInstance);
            setIsMapLoaded(true);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
          }
        };
        
        googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
        };
        
        document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
      } else if (!mapRef.current) {
        console.log('Map ref not ready, retrying in 100ms...');
        setTimeout(initializeMap, 100);
      }
    };
    
    // Add a small delay to ensure DOM is ready
    setTimeout(initializeMap, 100);
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                }}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 問題分析

❌ **JavaScript API 問題**: 可能是 API 限制或載入方式問題

## 解決方案

### 1. 檢查 Google Cloud Console 設定

請檢查你的 Google Cloud Console：

1. **API 限制**:
   - 確保 **Maps JavaScript API** 已啟用
   - 檢查 Browser Key 的限制設定

2. **HTTP 限制**:
   - 確保允許 `http://localhost:[PORT]/*`
   - 確保允許 `http://127.0.0.1:[PORT]/*`

### 2. 測試 JavaScript API 載入

讓我創建一個簡單的測試頁面來驗證 JavaScript API：


```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>Google Maps Test</title>
    <style>
        #map {
            height: 400px;
            width: 100%;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <h1>Google Maps API Test</h1>
    <div id="map"></div>
    
    <script>
        function initMap() {
            console.log('initMap called');
            const map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById("map"), {
                center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 },
                zoom: 12,
            });
            console.log('Map created:', map);
        }
        
        // Load Google Maps API
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=AIzaSy[MASKED_API_KEY]&callback=initMap';
        script.async = true;
        script.defer = true;
        
        script.onload = () => {
            console.log('Google Maps script loaded');
        };
        
        script.onerror = (error) => {
            console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
        };
        
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    const initializeMap = () => {
      if (!isMapLoaded && mapRef.current) {
        console.log('Initializing Google Maps...');
        const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
        googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places`;
        googleMapsScript.async = true;
        googleMapsScript.defer = true;
        
        googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
          console.log('Google Maps script loaded successfully');
          console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
          console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
          
          try {
            if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps) {
              const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current!, {
                center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
                zoom: 12,
              });
              
              console.log('Google Maps instance created:', !!mapInstance);
              setMap(mapInstance);
              setIsMapLoaded(true);
            } else {
              console.error('Google Maps API not available');
            }
          } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
          }
        };
        
        googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
        };
        
        document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
      } else if (!mapRef.current) {
        console.log('Map ref not ready, retrying in 100ms...');
        setTimeout(initializeMap, 100);
      }
    };
    
    // Add a small delay to ensure DOM is ready
    setTimeout(initializeMap, 100);
  }, [isMapLoaded, setMap, setIsMapLoaded]);

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {!isMapLoaded && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </Box>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {!isMapLoaded && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </Box>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

### 1. 修復重複創建和 API 濫用問題


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps
  useEffect(() => {
    let retryCount = 0;
    const maxRetries = 3;
    const retryDelay = 2000; // 2 seconds instead of 100ms
    
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    const initializeMap = () => {
      // Prevent multiple initializations
      if (isMapLoaded) {
        console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
        return;
      }
      
      if (!mapRef.current) {
        if (retryCount < maxRetries) {
          retryCount++;
          console.log(`Map ref not ready, retrying in ${retryDelay}ms... (attempt ${retryCount}/${maxRetries})`);
          setTimeout(initializeMap, retryDelay);
        } else {
          console.error('Max retries reached, map initialization failed');
        }
        return;
      }
      
      console.log('Initializing Google Maps...');
      
      // Check if script already exists
      const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
      if (existingScript) {
        console.log('Google Maps script already exists, using existing one');
        if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps) {
          createMap();
        } else {
          existingScript.addEventListener('load', createMap);
        }
      } else {
        const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
        googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&loading=async`;
        googleMapsScript.async = true;
        googleMapsScript.defer = true;
        
        googleMapsScript.onload = () => {
          console.log('Google Maps script loaded successfully');
          createMap();
        };
        
        googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
          console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
        };
        
        document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
      }
    };
    
    const createMap = () => {
      // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
      if (isMapLoaded) {
        console.log('Map already created, skipping');
        return;
      }
      
      console.log('Creating map instance...');
      console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
      console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
      
      try {
        if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && mapRef.current) {
          const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
            center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
            zoom: 12,
          });
          
          console.log('Google Maps instance created:', !!mapInstance);
          setMap(mapInstance);
          setIsMapLoaded(true);
        } else {
          console.error('Google Maps API not available or map ref not ready');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      }
    };
    
    // Add a delay to ensure DOM is ready
    setTimeout(initializeMap, 500);
  }, []); // Remove dependencies to prevent re-runs

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {!isMapLoaded && (
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                )}
              </Box>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {!isMapLoaded && (
                  <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                      載入地圖中...
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Box>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```
