I can see the issue! The error `TypeError: window.google.maps.Map is not a constructor` indicates that the Google Maps API isn't fully loaded when we try to create the map. The `test-map.html` works because it uses the `callback` parameter, which ensures the API is fully ready.

Let me fix this by using the same callback approach that works in the test file:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        createMap();
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Define global callback function
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      createMap();
    };
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, [isMapLoaded]); // Only run when isMapLoaded changes
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 100);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {!isMapLoaded && (
                  <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                      載入地圖中...
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Box>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 修復原理

**問題**: `onload` 事件觸發時，Google Maps API 腳本已載入，但 API 內部可能還沒完全初始化，導致 `Map` 構造函數不可用。

**解決方案**: 使用 `callback` 參數，讓 Google Maps API 在完全準備好後主動調用我們的函數，確保所有構造函數都可用。

這與 `test-map.html` 的成功方式完全一致！

```shellscript
npm run dev
```

```plaintext
Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded

Google Maps Map constructor: function
Google Maps instance created successfully: true
```

I can see the issue! The error `initMapCallback is not a function` means the global callback function isn't properly defined when Google Maps tries to call it. Also, `Map ref current: false` indicates the DOM element isn't ready.

Let me fix this by ensuring the callback is properly defined and handling the timing issues:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 100);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 100);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, [isMapLoaded]); // Only run when isMapLoaded changes
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 100);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                }}
              >
                {!isMapLoaded && (
                  <Box sx={{ textAlign: 'center' }}>
                    <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                      載入地圖中...
                    </Typography>
                  </Box>
                )}
              </Box>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 修復內容

### ✅ 關鍵修復：

1. **提前定義回調函數**: 在載入腳本之前就定義 `initMapCallback`，確保 Google Maps API 能找到它
2. **添加延遲**: 在回調函數中添加 100ms 延遲，確保 DOM 準備好
3. **改善重試機制**: 增加重試延遲到 200ms 和 500ms，給 DOM 更多時間
4. **添加 `loading=async`**: 解決 Google Maps 的性能警告
5. **更詳細的調試**: 檢查 `mapRef.current` 狀態

## 修復原理

**問題 1**: `initMapCallback is not a function` - 回調函數在腳本載入時還沒定義
**解決方案**: 在載入腳本之前就定義回調函數

**問題 2**: `Map ref current: false` - DOM 元素還沒準備好
**解決方案**: 添加延遲和重試機制，給 DOM 更多時間

**問題 3**: Google Maps 性能警告
**解決方案**: 添加 `loading=async` 參數

Perfect! I can see the issue now. The Google Maps is actually loading successfully (all the logs show it's working), but there's a React DOM conflict. The error `Failed to execute 'removeChild' on 'Node'` happens because Google Maps takes over the DOM element and React tries to remove the "載入地圖中..." text from it.

Let me fix this by changing how we handle the loading state:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 100);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 100);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, [isMapLoaded]); // Only run when isMapLoaded changes
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
        console.log('mapRef.current:', !!mapRef.current);
        
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
      <Box sx={{ display: 'flex', gap: 3, flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' } }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: { xs: 1, md: '0 0 400px' } }}>
          <Card>
            <CardContent>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ flex: 1 }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative' }}>
            <CardContent>
              <Typography variant="h6" gutterBottom>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  height: '500px',
                  width: '100%',
                  minHeight: '500px',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

Perfect! Now let's test the fix:

## 修復內容

### ✅ 關鍵修復：

**問題**: React DOM 衝突 - Google Maps 接管 DOM 元素後，React 嘗試移除「載入地圖中...」文字時發生 `removeChild` 錯誤

**解決方案**: 
1. **分離載入指示器**: 將「載入地圖中...」文字移到地圖容器外部
2. **使用絕對定位**: 載入指示器使用 `position: absolute` 覆蓋在地圖上方
3. **相對定位容器**: Card 容器設為 `position: relative` 作為絕對定位的參考點
4. **高 z-index**: 確保載入指示器在地圖上方顯示

## 測試步驟

### 1. 重新啟動前端
```bash
# 停止現有的前端 (Ctrl+C)
cd /mnt/d/WP/wp1141/hw4/frontend
npm run dev
```

### 2. 預期結果
現在你應該會看到：

- ✅ **地圖成功載入**: 顯示台北地圖
- ✅ **無 React 錯誤**: 不再有 `removeChild` 錯誤
- ✅ **載入指示器**: 「載入地圖中...」會覆蓋在地圖上方，然後消失
- ✅ **控制台乾淨**: 只有成功的地圖載入訊息

### 3. 檢查地圖功能
- 地圖應該可以縮放和拖曳
- 地圖應該顯示台北地區
- UI 布局應該正常

## 修復原理

**之前**: 載入文字在地圖容器內部 → Google Maps 接管容器 → React 無法移除文字 → DOM 錯誤

**現在**: 載入文字在地圖容器外部 → Google Maps 接管容器 → React 移除外部文字 → 無衝突

這解決了 React 虛擬 DOM 與 Google Maps 直接 DOM 操作之間的衝突！

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 100);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 100);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, [isMapLoaded]); // Only run when isMapLoaded changes
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
        console.log('mapRef.current:', !!mapRef.current);
        
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        height: 'calc(100vh - 200px)', // Set a specific height
        minHeight: '600px'
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>

        </Box>

        {/* Map */}

          >
            建立路線

        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};
```

```typescriptreact
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, [isMapLoaded]); // Only run when isMapLoaded changes
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
        console.log('mapRef.current:', !!mapRef.current);
        
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        height: 'calc(100vh - 200px)', // Set a specific height
        minHeight: '600px'
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 修復內容

### ✅ 布局修復：

1. **設定容器高度**: 主容器設為 `calc(100vh - 200px)` 確保有足夠空間
2. **固定左側面板**: 路線列表設為固定寬度 400px，防止被壓縮
3. **彈性地圖容器**: 地圖容器使用 `flex: 1` 佔滿剩餘空間
4. **防止收縮**: 添加 `minWidth: 0` 允許 flex 項目收縮
5. **垂直布局**: 地圖卡片使用垂直 flex 布局填滿高度

## 修復原理

**問題**: Flexbox 容器沒有明確的高度約束，導致地圖容器被壓縮

**解決方案**: 
- 設定明確的容器高度
- 使用 `flex: 1` 讓地圖容器填滿可用空間
- 固定左側面板寬度防止被壓縮

You're absolutely right! The issue is that the root container (`#root`) isn't taking up the full page height, which is causing the layout problems. Let me check and fix the root container styling.

```typescriptreact
      if (map) {

          lat: newRoute.start_lat,

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {

        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number) => {

    if (hours > 0) {

    return `${minutes}分鐘`;

  const formatDistance = (meters: number) => {
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {

      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />

  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>

      {error && (

            margin="dense"

            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
```
