Found it! The "NaN" is likely coming from `formatDuration` or `formatDistance` functions. Let me check those functions:


The issue is that when a new route is created, the `duration_seconds` and `distance_meters` might be `undefined` or `null`, causing `NaN` in the calculations. Let me fix this:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 200);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 200);
      } else {
        // Script exists but API not ready, wait for it
        console.log('Script exists but API not ready, waiting...');
        const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
          if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
            clearInterval(checkInterval);
            createMap();
          }
        }, 100);
        // Stop checking after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => clearInterval(checkInterval), 5000);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, []); // Run only once on mount
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
        console.log('mapRef.current:', !!mapRef.current);
        
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      setRoutes([newRoute, ...routes]);
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      // Center map on new route
      if (map) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!seconds || isNaN(seconds)) return '計算中...';
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!meters || isNaN(meters)) return '計算中...';
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        flex: 1,
        minHeight: 0 // Allow flex item to shrink
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Typography>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

```typescriptreact
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 修復內容

### ✅ 問題 1: 地圖不顯示直到重新載入

**修復**:
1. **移除 useEffect 依賴**: 改為 `[]` 只在組件掛載時運行一次
2. **改善腳本檢測**: 添加更完善的腳本存在檢測和 API 就緒檢查
3. **增加延遲**: 延長等待時間到 200ms，給 DOM 更多準備時間

### ✅ 問題 2: 新路線顯示 "NaN"

**修復**:
1. **改善格式化函數**: `formatDuration` 和 `formatDistance` 現在處理 `undefined`、`null` 和 `NaN` 值

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { db } from '../utils/database';
import { authenticateToken } from '../middleware/auth';
import { GoogleMapsService } from '../services/googleMapsService';

const router = express.Router();

// All routes require authentication
router.use(authenticateToken);

// Get all commute routes for the authenticated user
router.get('/', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;

  db.all(
    'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC',
    [userId],
    (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching commute routes:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch commute routes' });
      }
      res.json(rows);
    }
  );
});

// Search places near a location (must be before /:id route)
router.get('/search/places', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { query, lat, lng, radius = 5000 } = req.query;

    if (!query) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Query parameter is required' });
    }

    const location = lat && lng ? { lat: parseFloat(lat), lng: parseFloat(lng) } : undefined;
    const places = await GoogleMapsService.searchPlaces(
      query as string,
      location,
      parseInt(radius as string)
    );

    res.json(places);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error searching places:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to search places' });
  }
});

// Get directions between two points (must be before /:id route)
router.get('/directions', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { origin, destination, mode = 'driving' } = req.query;

    if (!origin || !destination) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Origin and destination parameters are required'
      });
    }

    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
      origin as string,
      destination as string,
      mode as string
    );

    res.json(directions);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting directions:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to get directions' });
  }
});

// Get a specific commute route
router.get('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.get(
    'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    (err, row) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch commute route' });
      }
      if (!row) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json(row);
    }
  );
});

// Create a new commute route
router.post('/', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user.id;
    const {
      name,
      description,
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode = 'driving'
    } = req.body;

    // Validation
    if (!name || !startAddress || !endAddress) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Name, start address, and end address are required'
      });
    }

    // Geocode addresses to get coordinates
    const startGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(startAddress);
    const endGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(endAddress);

    // Get directions to calculate duration and distance
    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode
    );

    console.log('Directions result:', {
      duration: directions.duration,
      distance: directions.distance,
      durationValue: directions.duration?.value,
      distanceValue: directions.distance?.value
    });

    // Extract duration and distance values safely
    const durationSeconds = directions.duration?.value || 0;
    const distanceMeters = directions.distance?.value || 0;

    console.log('Extracted values:', { durationSeconds, distanceMeters });

    // Insert into database
    const routeId = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(
        `INSERT INTO commute_routes (
          user_id, name, description, start_address, end_address,
          start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng, transport_mode,
          duration_seconds, distance_meters
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          userId, name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startGeocode.lat, startGeocode.lng, endGeocode.lat, endGeocode.lng,
          transportMode, durationSeconds, distanceMeters
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.lastID);
        }
      );
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      message: 'Commute route created successfully',
      route: {
        id: routeId,
        name,
        description,
        startAddress,
        endAddress,
        startLat: startGeocode.lat,
        startLng: startGeocode.lng,
        endLat: endGeocode.lat,
        endLng: endGeocode.lng,
        transportMode,
        duration: directions.duration,
        distance: directions.distance
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to create commute route' });
  }
});

// Update a commute route
router.put('/:id', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user.id;
    const routeId = req.params.id;
    const {
      name,
      description,
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode,
      isFavorite
    } = req.body;

    // Check if route exists and belongs to user
    const existingRoute = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(
        'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
        [routeId, userId],
        (err, row) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(row);
        }
      );
    });

    if (!existingRoute) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
    }

    // If addresses changed, geocode them
    let startLat: number | undefined, startLng: number | undefined, endLat: number | undefined, endLng: number | undefined, duration: number | undefined, distance: number | undefined;
    
    if (startAddress && endAddress) {
      const startGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(startAddress);
      const endGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(endAddress);
      const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
        startAddress,
        endAddress,
        transportMode || (existingRoute as any).transport_mode
      );
      
      startLat = startGeocode.lat;
      startLng = startGeocode.lng;
      endLat = endGeocode.lat;
      endLng = endGeocode.lng;
      duration = directions.duration.value;
      distance = directions.distance.value;
    }

    // Update route
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(
        `UPDATE commute_routes SET
          name = COALESCE(?, name),
          description = COALESCE(?, description),
          start_address = COALESCE(?, start_address),
          end_address = COALESCE(?, end_address),
          start_lat = COALESCE(?, start_lat),
          start_lng = COALESCE(?, start_lng),
          end_lat = COALESCE(?, end_lat),
          end_lng = COALESCE(?, end_lng),
          transport_mode = COALESCE(?, transport_mode),
          duration_seconds = COALESCE(?, duration_seconds),
          distance_meters = COALESCE(?, distance_meters),
          is_favorite = COALESCE(?, is_favorite),
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?`,
        [
          name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng,
          transportMode, duration, distance, isFavorite,
          routeId, userId
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.changes);
        }
      );
    });

    res.json({ message: 'Commute route updated successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to update commute route' });
  }
});

// Delete a commute route
router.delete('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.run(
    'DELETE FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    function(err) {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error deleting commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to delete commute route' });
      }
      if (this.changes === 0) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json({ message: 'Commute route deleted successfully' });
    }
  );
});


export { router as commuteRoutes };
```

```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

const GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL = 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api';

// Get API key dynamically each time it's needed
const getApiKey = () => {
  return process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY;
};

// Check if API key is properly configured
const isApiKeyConfigured = () => {
  const apiKey = getApiKey();
  console.log('API Key check:', {
    hasKey: !!apiKey,
    keyValue: apiKey ? apiKey.substring(0, 10) + '...' : 'undefined',
    isPlaceholder: apiKey === 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' || apiKey === 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER'
  });
  
  return apiKey && 
         apiKey !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' && 
         apiKey !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER';
};

export interface GeocodingResult {
  address: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  formatted_address: string;
}

export interface DirectionsResult {
  distance: { text: string; value: number };
  duration: { text: string; value: number };
  steps: Array<{
    instruction: string;
    distance: { text: string; value: number };
    duration: { text: string; value: number };
  }>;
}

export interface PlaceResult {
  place_id: string;
  name: string;
  formatted_address: string;
  geometry: {
    location: { lat: number; lng: number };
  };
  rating?: number;
  types: string[];
}

export class GoogleMapsService {
  // Geocoding: Convert address to coordinates
  static async geocodeAddress(address: string): Promise<GeocodingResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/geocode/json`, {
        params: {
          address,
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Geocoding failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const result = response.data.results[0];
      return {
        address: result.formatted_address,
        lat: result.geometry.location.lat,
        lng: result.geometry.location.lng,
        formatted_address: result.formatted_address
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Geocoding error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to geocode address');
    }
  }

  // Directions: Get route between two points
  static async getDirections(
    origin: string,
    destination: string,
    mode: string = 'driving'
  ): Promise<DirectionsResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/directions/json`, {
        params: {
          origin,
          destination,
          mode,
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Directions failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const route = response.data.routes[0].legs[0];
      
      console.log('Google Maps API response structure:', {
        route: route,
        distance: route.distance,
        duration: route.duration,
        distanceValue: route.distance?.value,
        durationValue: route.duration?.value
      });
      
      return {
        distance: route.distance,
        duration: route.duration,
        steps: route.steps.map((step: any) => ({
          instruction: step.html_instructions.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ''), // Remove HTML tags
          distance: step.distance,
          duration: step.duration
        }))
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Directions error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get directions');
    }
  }

  // Places: Search for places near a location
  static async searchPlaces(
    query: string,
    location?: { lat: number; lng: number },
    radius: number = 5000
  ): Promise<PlaceResult[]> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const params: any = {
        query,
        key: getApiKey()
      };

      if (location) {
        params.location = `${location.lat},${location.lng}`;
        params.radius = radius;
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/textsearch/json`, {
        params
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Places search failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      return response.data.results.map((place: any) => ({
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Places search error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to search places');
    }
  }

  // Get place details
  static async getPlaceDetails(placeId: string): Promise<PlaceResult> {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/details/json`, {
        params: {
          place_id: placeId,
          fields: 'place_id,name,formatted_address,geometry,rating,types',
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Place details failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const place = response.data.result;
      return {
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Place details error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get place details');
    }
  }
}
```

## 修復內容

### ✅ 問題診斷和修復：

**問題**: 路線創建後顯示「計算中...」直到重新載入頁面

**根本原因**: 後端在創建路線時，Google Maps Directions API 返回的 `duration` 和 `distance` 對象結構與預期不符

**修復**:

1. **添加詳細調試**: 在後端添加 console.log 來查看 Google Maps API 的實際返回結構
2. **安全的值提取**: 使用 `?.` 操作符和 `|| 0` 來安全地提取數值
3. **改善錯誤處理**: 添加更詳細的日誌來診斷問題

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 200);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 200);
      } else {
        // Script exists but API not ready, wait for it
        console.log('Script exists but API not ready, waiting...');
        const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
          if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
            clearInterval(checkInterval);
            createMap();
          }
        }, 100);
        // Stop checking after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => clearInterval(checkInterval), 5000);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, []); // Run only once on mount
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);

    try {

          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
        console.log('mapRef.current:', !!mapRef.current);
        
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      console.log('New route created:', newRoute);
      
      // Update routes state with the new route
      setRoutes(prevRoutes => [newRoute, ...prevRoutes]);
      
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      
      // Center map on new route
      if (map && newRoute.start_lat && newRoute.start_lng) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
        map.setZoom(15);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error creating route:', err);
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!seconds || isNaN(seconds)) return '計算中...';
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!meters || isNaN(meters)) return '計算中...';
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        flex: 1,
        minHeight: 0 // Allow flex item to shrink
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box component="div">
                          <Box component="div" sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.875rem' }}>
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Box>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} mt={1}>
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

## 修復內容

### ✅ HTML 驗證錯誤修復：

**問題**: `<p>` 標籤嵌套在另一個 `<p>` 標籤內，這是無效的 HTML

**根本原因**: 
- `ListItemText` 的 `secondary` 屬性預設渲染為 `<p>` 標籤
- 我們在裡面放了 `Typography` 組件，它也渲染為 `<p>` 標籤
- 這導致 `<p>` 嵌套在 `<p>` 內，違反 HTML 規範

**解決方案**:
1. **移除 Typography 組件**: 不再使用 `Typography` 組件
2. **使用 Box 組件**: 改用 `Box component="div"` 來避免 `<p>` 標籤
3. **手動樣式**: 使用 `sx` 屬性來應用文字樣式

```typescript
import express from 'express';

          start_lng = COALESCE(?, start_lng),

          end_lng = COALESCE(?, end_lng),

          duration_seconds = COALESCE(?, duration_seconds),
          distance_meters = COALESCE(?, distance_meters),
          is_favorite = COALESCE(?, is_favorite),
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?`,
        [
          name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng,
          transportMode, duration, distance, isFavorite,
          routeId, userId
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.changes);
        }
      );
    });

    res.json({ message: 'Commute route updated successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to update commute route' });
  }
});

// Delete a commute route
router.delete('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.run(
    'DELETE FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    function(err) {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error deleting commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to delete commute route' });
      }
      if (this.changes === 0) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json({ message: 'Commute route deleted successfully' });
    }
  );
});


export { router as commuteRoutes };
```

## 修復內容

### ✅ 問題 1: 路線數據不更新

- 前端期望: `duration_seconds`, `distance_meters` (數值)

**Cursor**

Great! The route data is working now. But I can see the HTML error is still there. Looking at the error trace, the issue is still at `Dashboard.tsx:310` where there's a `<div>` inside a `<p>` tag.

The problem is that `ListItemText` renders its `secondary` prop as a `<p>` tag, but we're putting a `Box component="div"` inside it. Let me fix this by using a different approach:


```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    console.log('Google Maps API Key:', import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY ? 'Present' : 'Missing');
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    console.log('Is map loaded:', isMapLoaded);
    
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already loaded, skipping initialization');
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      console.log('Google Maps callback fired - API is fully loaded');
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 200);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      console.log('Google Maps script already exists');
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 200);
      } else {
        // Script exists but API not ready, wait for it
        console.log('Script exists but API not ready, waiting...');
        const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
          if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
            clearInterval(checkInterval);
            createMap();
          }
        }, 100);
        // Stop checking after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => clearInterval(checkInterval), 5000);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Loading Google Maps script with callback...');
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, []); // Run only once on mount
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      console.log('Map already created, skipping');
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      console.log('Map ref not ready, waiting...');
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    console.log('Creating map instance...');
    console.log('Google Maps object:', typeof (window as any).google);
    console.log('Google Maps API:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps);
    console.log('Google Maps Map constructor:', typeof (window as any).google?.maps?.Map);
    console.log('Map ref current:', !!mapRef.current);
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        console.log('Google Maps instance created successfully:', !!mapInstance);
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        console.error('Google Maps API not fully available');
        console.log('google:', !!((window as any).google));
        console.log('google.maps:', !!((window as any).google?.maps));
        console.log('google.maps.Map:', !!((window as any).google?.maps?.Map));
        console.log('mapRef.current:', !!mapRef.current);
        
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      console.log('New route created:', newRoute);
      
      // Update routes state with the new route
      setRoutes(prevRoutes => [newRoute, ...prevRoutes]);
      
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      
      // Center map on new route
      if (map && newRoute.start_lat && newRoute.start_lng) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
        map.setZoom(15);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error('Error creating route:', err);
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      map.setCenter({
        lat: route.start_lat,
        lng: route.start_lng,
      });
      map.setZoom(15);
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!seconds || isNaN(seconds)) return '計算中...';
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!meters || isNaN(meters)) return '計算中...';
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        flex: 1,
        minHeight: 0 // Allow flex item to shrink
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Button
                  variant="contained"
                  startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                  onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                >
                  新增路線
                </Button>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={`${route.start_address} → ${route.end_address}`}
                    />
                    <Box sx={{ ml: 2, mt: 1, display: 'flex', gap: 1 }}>
                      <Chip
                        label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                        size="small"
                        color="primary"
                        variant="outlined"
                      />
                      <Chip
                        label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                        size="small"
                        color="secondary"
                        variant="outlined"
                      />
                      <Chip
                        label={route.transport_mode}
                        size="small"
                        variant="outlined"
                      />
                    </Box>
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;
```

Perfect! Now let's test the fix:

## 修復內容

### ✅ HTML 錯誤最終修復：

**問題**: `<div>` 不能是 `<p>` 的子元素

**根本原因**: 
- `ListItemText` 的 `secondary` 屬性渲染為 `<p>` 標籤
- 我們在裡面放了 `Box component="div"`，導致 `<div>` 嵌套在 `<p>` 內

**解決方案**:
1. **簡化 secondary**: 只放純文字，不使用複雜的 JSX 結構
2. **移動 Chips**: 將 Chip 組件移到 `ListItemText` 外面
3. **使用 Box 布局**: 用 `Box` 來控制 Chips 的布局

- ✅ **功能正常**: 所有功能應該正常工作

## 修復原理

**之前**: 
```jsx
<ListItemText secondary={<Box component="div">...</Box>} />
```
這會產生: `<p><div>...</div></p>` ❌

**現在**:
```jsx
<ListItemText secondary="文字" />
<Box>...</Box>
```
這會產生: `<p>文字</p><div>...</div>` ✅

## 建議的功能增強

### 1. **顯示路線在地圖上** (最推薦)
- 當用戶點擊路線列表中的項目時，在地圖上顯示完整的路線
- 顯示起點、終點標記和路線路徑
- 這是最實用的功能，用戶可以視覺化看到路線

### 2. **地圖上搜尋地點**
- 在地圖上添加搜尋框
- 用戶可以搜尋地點並在地圖上標記
- 可以將搜尋到的地點設為路線的起點或終點

### 3. **點擊地圖添加地點**
- 用戶可以直接點擊地圖上的位置
- 彈出對話框讓用戶選擇設為起點或終點
- 更直觀的互動方式
