                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Box sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.875rem', mb: 1 }}>
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Box>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} flexWrap="wrap">
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { authRoutes } from './routes/auth';
import { commuteRoutes } from './routes/commute';
import { errorHandler } from './middleware/errorHandler';
import { initializeDatabase } from './utils/database';

// Load environment variables
dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3000;

// Middleware
app.use(cors({
  origin: process.env.CORS_ORIGINS?.split(',') || ['http://localhost:[PORT]', 'http://127.0.0.1:[PORT]'],
  credentials: true
}));
app.use(express.json());
app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true }));

// Routes
app.use('/auth', authRoutes);
app.use('/api/commute', commuteRoutes);

// Health check endpoint
app.get('/health', (req, res) => {
  res.json({ status: 'OK', message: 'Commute Map API is running' });
});

// Error handling middleware
app.use(errorHandler);

// Initialize database and start server
const startServer = async () => {
  try {
    await initializeDatabase();
    console.log('Database initialized successfully');

    app.listen(PORT, () => {
      console.log(`🚀 Server running on port ${PORT}`);
      console.log(`📍 Health check: http://localhost:${PORT}/health`);
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to start server:', error);
    process.exit(1);
  }
};

startServer();

```typescript
import axios from 'axios';

const GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL = 'https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api';

// Get API key dynamically each time it's needed
const getApiKey = () => {
  return process.env.GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY;
};

// Check if API key is properly configured
const isApiKeyConfigured = () => {
  const apiKey = getApiKey();
  return apiKey &&
         apiKey !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY' &&
         apiKey !== 'YOUR_SERVER_KEY_PLACEHOLDER';
};

export interface GeocodingResult {
  address: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  formatted_address: string;
}

export interface DirectionsResult {
  distance: { text: string; value: number };
  duration: { text: string; value: number };
  steps: Array<{
    instruction: string;
    distance: { text: string; value: number };
    duration: { text: string; value: number };
  }>;
}

export interface PlaceResult {
  place_id: string;
  name: string;
  formatted_address: string;
  geometry: {
    location: { lat: number; lng: number };
  };
  rating?: number;
  types: string[];
}

export class GoogleMapsService {
  // Geocoding: Convert address to coordinates
  static async geocodeAddress(address: string): Promise<GeocodingResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/geocode/json`, {
        params: {
          address,
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Geocoding failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const result = response.data.results[0];
      return {
        address: result.formatted_address,
        lat: result.geometry.location.lat,
        lng: result.geometry.location.lng,
        formatted_address: result.formatted_address
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Geocoding error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to geocode address');
    }
  }

  // Directions: Get route between two points
  static async getDirections(
    origin: string,
    destination: string,
    mode: string = 'driving'
  ): Promise<DirectionsResult> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/directions/json`, {
        params: {
          origin,
          destination,
          mode,
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Directions failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const route = response.data.routes[0].legs[0];
      
      console.log('Google Maps API response structure:', {
        route: route,
        distance: route.distance,
        duration: route.duration,
        distanceValue: route.distance?.value,
        durationValue: route.duration?.value
      });
      
      return {
        distance: route.distance,
        duration: route.duration,
        steps: route.steps.map((step: any) => ({
          instruction: step.html_instructions.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ''), // Remove HTML tags
          distance: step.distance,
          duration: step.duration
        }))
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Directions error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get directions');
    }
  }

  // Places: Search for places near a location
  static async searchPlaces(
    query: string,
    location?: { lat: number; lng: number },
    radius: number = 5000
  ): Promise<PlaceResult[]> {
    try {
      // Check if API key is configured
      if (!isApiKeyConfigured()) {
        throw new Error('Google Maps API key is not configured. Please set GOOGLE_MAPS_SERVER_KEY in your .env file');
      }

      const params: any = {
        query,
        key: getApiKey()
      };

      if (location) {
        params.location = `${location.lat},${location.lng}`;
        params.radius = radius;
      }

      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/textsearch/json`, {
        params
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Places search failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      return response.data.results.map((place: any) => ({
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      }));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Places search error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to search places');
    }
  }

  // Get place details
  static async getPlaceDetails(placeId: string): Promise<PlaceResult> {
    try {
      const response = await axios.get(`${GOOGLE_MAPS_BASE_URL}/place/details/json`, {
        params: {
          place_id: placeId,
          fields: 'place_id,name,formatted_address,geometry,rating,types',
          key: getApiKey()
        }
      });

      if (response.data.status !== 'OK') {
        throw new Error(`Place details failed: ${response.data.status}`);
      }

      const place = response.data.result;
      return {
        place_id: place.place_id,
        name: place.name,
        formatted_address: place.formatted_address,
        geometry: place.geometry,
        rating: place.rating,
        types: place.types
      };
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Place details error:', error);
      throw new Error('Failed to get place details');
    }
  }
}

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { db } from '../utils/database';
import { authenticateToken } from '../middleware/auth';
import { GoogleMapsService } from '../services/googleMapsService';

const router = express.Router();

// All routes require authentication
router.use(authenticateToken);

// Get all commute routes for the authenticated user
router.get('/', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;

  db.all(
    'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC',
    [userId],
    (err, rows) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching commute routes:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch commute routes' });
      }
      res.json(rows);
    }
  );
});

// Search places near a location (must be before /:id route)
router.get('/search/places', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { query, lat, lng, radius = 5000 } = req.query;

    if (!query) {
      return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Query parameter is required' });
    }

    const location = lat && lng ? { lat: parseFloat(lat), lng: parseFloat(lng) } : undefined;
    const places = await GoogleMapsService.searchPlaces(
      query as string,
      location,
      parseInt(radius as string)
    );

    res.json(places);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error searching places:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to search places' });
  }
});

// Get directions between two points (must be before /:id route)
router.get('/directions', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const { origin, destination, mode = 'driving' } = req.query;

    if (!origin || !destination) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Origin and destination parameters are required'
      });
    }

    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
      origin as string,
      destination as string,
      mode as string
    );

    res.json(directions);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error getting directions:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to get directions' });
  }
});

// Get a specific commute route
router.get('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.get(
    'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    (err, row) => {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error fetching commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to fetch commute route' });
      }
      if (!row) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json(row);
    }
  );
});

// Create a new commute route
router.post('/', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user.id;
    const {
      name,
      description,
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode = 'driving'
    } = req.body;

    // Validation
    if (!name || !startAddress || !endAddress) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        error: 'Name, start address, and end address are required'
      });
    }

    // Geocode addresses to get coordinates
    const startGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(startAddress);
    const endGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(endAddress);

    // Get directions to calculate duration and distance
    const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode
    );

    // Extract duration and distance values safely
    const durationSeconds = directions.duration?.value || 0;
    const distanceMeters = directions.distance?.value || 0;

    // Insert into database
    const routeId = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(
        `INSERT INTO commute_routes (
          user_id, name, description, start_address, end_address,
          start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng, transport_mode,
          duration_seconds, distance_meters
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
        [
          userId, name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startGeocode.lat, startGeocode.lng, endGeocode.lat, endGeocode.lng,
          transportMode, durationSeconds, distanceMeters
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.lastID);
        }
      );
    });

    res.status(201).json({
      message: 'Commute route created successfully',
      route: {
        id: routeId,
        name,
        description,
        start_address: startAddress,
        end_address: endAddress,
        start_lat: startGeocode.lat,
        start_lng: startGeocode.lng,
        end_lat: endGeocode.lat,
        end_lng: endGeocode.lng,
        transport_mode: transportMode,
        duration_seconds: durationSeconds,
        distance_meters: distanceMeters,
        is_favorite: false
      }
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error creating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to create commute route' });
  }
});

// Update a commute route
router.put('/:id', async (req: any, res) => {
  try {
    const userId = req.user.id;
    const routeId = req.params.id;
    const {
      name,
      description,
      startAddress,
      endAddress,
      transportMode,
      isFavorite
    } = req.body;

    // Check if route exists and belongs to user
    const existingRoute = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.get(
        'SELECT * FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
        [routeId, userId],
        (err, row) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(row);
        }
      );
    });

    if (!existingRoute) {
      return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
    }

    // If addresses changed, geocode them
    let startLat: number | undefined, startLng: number | undefined, endLat: number | undefined, endLng: number | undefined, duration: number | undefined, distance: number | undefined;
    
    if (startAddress && endAddress) {
      const startGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(startAddress);
      const endGeocode = await GoogleMapsService.geocodeAddress(endAddress);
      const directions = await GoogleMapsService.getDirections(
        startAddress,
        endAddress,
        transportMode || (existingRoute as any).transport_mode
      );
      
      startLat = startGeocode.lat;
      startLng = startGeocode.lng;
      endLat = endGeocode.lat;
      endLng = endGeocode.lng;
      duration = directions.duration.value;
      distance = directions.distance.value;
    }

    // Update route
    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      db.run(
        `UPDATE commute_routes SET
          name = COALESCE(?, name),
          description = COALESCE(?, description),
          start_address = COALESCE(?, start_address),
          end_address = COALESCE(?, end_address),
          start_lat = COALESCE(?, start_lat),
          start_lng = COALESCE(?, start_lng),
          end_lat = COALESCE(?, end_lat),
          end_lng = COALESCE(?, end_lng),
          transport_mode = COALESCE(?, transport_mode),
          duration_seconds = COALESCE(?, duration_seconds),
          distance_meters = COALESCE(?, distance_meters),
          is_favorite = COALESCE(?, is_favorite),
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?`,
        [
          name, description, startAddress, endAddress,
          startLat, startLng, endLat, endLng,
          transportMode, duration, distance, isFavorite,
          routeId, userId
        ],
        function(err) {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(this.changes);
        }
      );
    });

    res.json({ message: 'Commute route updated successfully' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error updating commute route:', error);
    res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to update commute route' });
  }
});

// Delete a commute route
router.delete('/:id', (req: any, res) => {
  const userId = req.user.id;
  const routeId = req.params.id;

  db.run(
    'DELETE FROM commute_routes WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?',
    [routeId, userId],
    function(err) {
      if (err) {
        console.error('Error deleting commute route:', err);
        return res.status(500).json({ error: 'Failed to delete commute route' });
      }
      if (this.changes === 0) {
        return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Commute route not found' });
      }
      res.json({ message: 'Commute route deleted successfully' });
    }
  );
});


export { router as commuteRoutes };

```

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searchField, setSearchField] = useState<'start' | 'end' | null>(null);
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 200);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 200);
      } else {
        // Script exists but API not ready, wait for it
        const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
          if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
            clearInterval(checkInterval);
            createMap();
          }
        }, 100);
        // Stop checking after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => clearInterval(checkInterval), 5000);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, []); // Run only once on mount
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      
      // Update routes state with the new route
      setRoutes(prevRoutes => [newRoute, ...prevRoutes]);
      
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      
      // Center map on new route
      if (map && newRoute.start_lat && newRoute.start_lng) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
        map.setZoom(15);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      // Clear existing markers and polylines
      clearMapOverlays();
      
      // Center map on route
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      
      // Add start marker
      const startMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: `起點: ${route.start_address}`,
        icon: {
          url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/green-dot.png'
        }
      });
      
      // Add end marker
      const endMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: `終點: ${route.end_address}`,
        icon: {
          url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/red-dot.png'
        }
      });
      
      // Store markers for cleanup
      (window as any).mapMarkers = [startMarker, endMarker];
      
      // Add route polyline
      const directionsService = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsService();
      const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer({
        suppressMarkers: true, // We're using custom markers
        polylineOptions: {
          strokeColor: '#1976d2',
          strokeWeight: 4,
          strokeOpacity: 0.8
        }
      });
      
      directionsRenderer.setMap(map);
      (window as any).directionsRenderer = directionsRenderer;
      
      // Get directions
      directionsService.route({
        origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        travelMode: (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode[route.transport_mode.toUpperCase()] || (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING
      }, (result: any, status: any) => {
        if (status === 'OK') {
          directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
          
          // Fit map to show entire route
          const routeBounds = result.routes[0].bounds;
          map.fitBounds(routeBounds);
        } else {
          console.error('Directions request failed:', status);
          // Fallback: just center on start point
          map.setCenter({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
          map.setZoom(12);
        }
      });
      
      // Extend bounds to include both markers
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      
      // Fit map to bounds with some padding
      map.fitBounds(bounds);
    }
  };

  const clearMapOverlays = () => {
    // Clear markers
    if ((window as any).mapMarkers) {
      (window as any).mapMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).mapMarkers = [];
    }
    
    // Clear directions
    if ((window as any).directionsRenderer) {
      (window as any).directionsRenderer.setMap(null);
      (window as any).directionsRenderer = null;
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!seconds || isNaN(seconds)) return '計算中...';
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!meters || isNaN(meters)) return '計算中...';
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        flex: 1,
        minHeight: 0 // Allow flex item to shrink
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Box display="flex" gap={1}>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    size="small"
                    onClick={clearMapOverlays}
                    disabled={!isMapLoaded}
                  >
                    清除地圖
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                  >
                    新增路線
                  </Button>
                </Box>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Box sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.875rem', mb: 1 }}>
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Box>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} flexWrap="wrap">
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />

                ))}
              </List>

        </Box>

```typescriptreact
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Box,
  Card,
  CardContent,
  Typography,
  Button,
  TextField,
  Dialog,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogContent,
  DialogActions,
  List,
  ListItem,
  ListItemText,
  ListItemSecondaryAction,
  IconButton,
  Chip,
  Alert,
  CircularProgress,
} from '@mui/material';
import {
  Add as AddIcon,
  Delete as DeleteIcon,
  Star as StarIcon,
  StarBorder as StarBorderIcon,
} from '@mui/icons-material';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { useMap } from '../contexts/MapContext';
import { commuteService } from '../services/commuteService';
import type { CommuteRoute, CreateRouteData } from '../services/commuteService';

const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const { } = useAuth();
  const { map, setMap, isMapLoaded, setIsMapLoaded } = useMap();
  const [routes, setRoutes] = useState<CommuteRoute[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [openDialog, setOpenDialog] = useState(false);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<CreateRouteData>({
    name: '',
    description: '',
    startAddress: '',
    endAddress: '',
    transportMode: 'driving',
  });
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searchField, setSearchField] = useState<'start' | 'end' | null>(null);
  const mapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  // Load routes on component mount
  useEffect(() => {
    loadRoutes();
  }, []);

  // Initialize Google Maps using callback approach (like test-map.html)
  useEffect(() => {
    // Prevent multiple initializations
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      return;
    }
    
    // Define global callback function FIRST, before any script loading
    (window as any).initMapCallback = () => {
      // Wait a bit for DOM to be ready
      setTimeout(() => {
        createMap();
      }, 200);
    };
    
    // Check if script already exists
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="maps.googleapis.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      // If script exists but map not loaded, try to create map directly
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
        setTimeout(() => createMap(), 200);
      } else {
        // Script exists but API not ready, wait for it
        const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
          if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map) {
            clearInterval(checkInterval);
            createMap();
          }
        }, 100);
        // Stop checking after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => clearInterval(checkInterval), 5000);
      }
      return;
    }
    
    // Create script with callback parameter (like test-map.html)
    const googleMapsScript = document.createElement('script');
    googleMapsScript.src = `https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/js?key=${import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_JS_KEY}&libraries=places&callback=initMapCallback&loading=async`;
    googleMapsScript.async = true;
    googleMapsScript.defer = true;
    
    googleMapsScript.onerror = (error) => {
      console.error('Error loading Google Maps script:', error);
    };
    
    document.head.appendChild(googleMapsScript);
    
    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      // Remove global callback
      delete (window as any).initMapCallback;
    };
  }, []); // Run only once on mount
    
  const createMap = () => {
    // Double-check to prevent multiple map instances
    if (isMapLoaded) {
      return;
    }
    
    if (!mapRef.current) {
      setTimeout(createMap, 200);
      return;
    }
    
    try {
      if ((window as any).google && (window as any).google.maps && (window as any).google.maps.Map && mapRef.current) {
        const mapInstance = new (window as any).google.maps.Map(mapRef.current, {
          center: { lat: 25.0330, lng: 121.5654 }, // Taipei coordinates
          zoom: 12,
        });
        
        setMap(mapInstance);
        setIsMapLoaded(true);
      } else {
        // Retry after a delay
        setTimeout(createMap, 500);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error creating Google Maps instance:', error);
      // Retry after a delay
      setTimeout(createMap, 500);
    }
  };

  const loadRoutes = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const routesData = await commuteService.getRoutes();
      setRoutes(routesData);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateRoute = async () => {
    try {
      const newRoute = await commuteService.createRoute(formData);
      
      // Update routes state with the new route
      setRoutes(prevRoutes => [newRoute, ...prevRoutes]);
      
      setOpenDialog(false);
      setFormData({
        name: '',
        description: '',
        startAddress: '',
        endAddress: '',
        transportMode: 'driving',
      });
      
      // Center map on new route
      if (map && newRoute.start_lat && newRoute.start_lng) {
        map.setCenter({
          lat: newRoute.start_lat,
          lng: newRoute.start_lng,
        });
        map.setZoom(15);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteRoute = async (id: number) => {
    if (window.confirm('確定要刪除此路線嗎？')) {
      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      // Clear existing markers and polylines
      clearMapOverlays();
      
      // Center map on route
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      
      // Add start marker
      const startMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: `起點: ${route.start_address}`,
        icon: {
          url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/green-dot.png'
        }
      });
      
      // Add end marker
      const endMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: `終點: ${route.end_address}`,
        icon: {
          url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/red-dot.png'
        }
      });
      
      // Store markers for cleanup
      (window as any).mapMarkers = [startMarker, endMarker];
      
      // Add route polyline
      const directionsService = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsService();
      const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer({
        suppressMarkers: true, // We're using custom markers
        polylineOptions: {
          strokeColor: '#1976d2',
          strokeWeight: 4,
          strokeOpacity: 0.8
        }
      });
      
      directionsRenderer.setMap(map);
      (window as any).directionsRenderer = directionsRenderer;
      
      // Get directions
      directionsService.route({
        origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        travelMode: (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode[route.transport_mode.toUpperCase()] || (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING
      }, (result: any, status: any) => {
        if (status === 'OK') {
          directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
          
          // Fit map to show entire route
          const routeBounds = result.routes[0].bounds;
          map.fitBounds(routeBounds);
        } else {
          console.error('Directions request failed:', status);
          // Fallback: just center on start point
          map.setCenter({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
          map.setZoom(12);
        }
      });
      
      // Extend bounds to include both markers
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      
      // Fit map to bounds with some padding
      map.fitBounds(bounds);
    }
  };

  const clearMapOverlays = () => {
    // Clear markers
    if ((window as any).mapMarkers) {
      (window as any).mapMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).mapMarkers = [];
    }
    
    // Clear directions
    if ((window as any).directionsRenderer) {
      (window as any).directionsRenderer.setMap(null);
      (window as any).directionsRenderer = null;
    }
    
    // Clear search markers
    if ((window as any).searchMarkers) {
      (window as any).searchMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).searchMarkers = [];
    }
  };

  const searchPlaces = async (query: string) => {
    if (!query.trim() || !map) return;
    
    setIsSearching(true);
    try {
      const response = await commuteService.searchPlaces(query);
      setSearchResults(response.results || []);
      
      // Clear existing search markers
      if ((window as any).searchMarkers) {
        (window as any).searchMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      }
      
      // Add markers for search results
      const markers: any[] = [];
      response.results?.forEach((place: any) => {
        const marker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
          position: { lat: place.geometry.location.lat, lng: place.geometry.location.lng },
          map: map,
          title: place.name,
          icon: {
            url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/blue-dot.png'
          }
        });
        
        // Add click listener to select place
        marker.addListener('click', () => {
          selectPlace(place);
        });
        
        markers.push(marker);
      });
      
      (window as any).searchMarkers = markers;
      
      // Fit map to show all results
      if (response.results && response.results.length > 0) {
        const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
        response.results.forEach((place: any) => {
          bounds.extend({ lat: place.geometry.location.lat, lng: place.geometry.location.lng });
        });
        map.fitBounds(bounds);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error searching places:', error);
      setError('搜尋地點時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const selectPlace = (place: any) => {
    if (searchField === 'start') {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, startAddress: place.formatted_address }));
    } else if (searchField === 'end') {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, endAddress: place.formatted_address }));
    }
    
    // Clear search results and markers
    setSearchResults([]);
    setSearchQuery('');
    setSearchField(null);
    
    if ((window as any).searchMarkers) {
      (window as any).searchMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).searchMarkers = [];
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!seconds || isNaN(seconds)) return '計算中...';
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!meters || isNaN(meters)) return '計算中...';
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        flex: 1,
        minHeight: 0 // Allow flex item to shrink
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Box display="flex" gap={1}>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    size="small"
                    onClick={clearMapOverlays}
                    disabled={!isMapLoaded}
                  >
                    清除地圖
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                  >
                    新增路線
                  </Button>
                </Box>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Box sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.875rem', mb: 1 }}>
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Box>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} flexWrap="wrap">
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="起點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.startAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="終點地址"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.endAddress}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

      try {
        await commuteService.deleteRoute(id);
        setRoutes(routes.filter(route => route.id !== id));
      } catch (err: any) {
        setError(err.message);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleFavorite = async (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    try {
      await commuteService.updateRoute(route.id, { isFavorite: !route.is_favorite });
      setRoutes(routes.map(r => 
        r.id === route.id ? { ...r, is_favorite: !r.is_favorite } : r
      ));
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message);
    }
  };

  const handleRouteClick = (route: CommuteRoute) => {
    if (map) {
      // Clear existing markers and polylines
      clearMapOverlays();
      
      // Center map on route
      const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
      
      // Add start marker
      const startMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        map: map,
        title: `起點: ${route.start_address}`,
        icon: {
          url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/green-dot.png'
        }
      });
      
      // Add end marker
      const endMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
        position: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        map: map,
        title: `終點: ${route.end_address}`,
        icon: {
          url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/red-dot.png'
        }
      });
      
      // Store markers for cleanup
      (window as any).mapMarkers = [startMarker, endMarker];
      
      // Add route polyline
      const directionsService = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsService();
      const directionsRenderer = new (window as any).google.maps.DirectionsRenderer({
        suppressMarkers: true, // We're using custom markers
        polylineOptions: {
          strokeColor: '#1976d2',
          strokeWeight: 4,
          strokeOpacity: 0.8
        }
      });
      
      directionsRenderer.setMap(map);
      (window as any).directionsRenderer = directionsRenderer;
      
      // Get directions
      directionsService.route({
        origin: { lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng },
        destination: { lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng },
        travelMode: (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode[route.transport_mode.toUpperCase()] || (window as any).google.maps.TravelMode.DRIVING
      }, (result: any, status: any) => {
        if (status === 'OK') {
          directionsRenderer.setDirections(result);
          
          // Fit map to show entire route
          const routeBounds = result.routes[0].bounds;
          map.fitBounds(routeBounds);
        } else {
          console.error('Directions request failed:', status);
          // Fallback: just center on start point
          map.setCenter({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
          map.setZoom(12);
        }
      });
      
      // Extend bounds to include both markers
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.start_lat, lng: route.start_lng });
      bounds.extend({ lat: route.end_lat, lng: route.end_lng });
      
      // Fit map to bounds with some padding
      map.fitBounds(bounds);
    }
  };

  const clearMapOverlays = () => {
    // Clear markers
    if ((window as any).mapMarkers) {
      (window as any).mapMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).mapMarkers = [];
    }
    
    // Clear directions
    if ((window as any).directionsRenderer) {
      (window as any).directionsRenderer.setMap(null);
      (window as any).directionsRenderer = null;
    }
    
    // Clear search markers
    if ((window as any).searchMarkers) {
      (window as any).searchMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).searchMarkers = [];
    }
  };

  const searchPlaces = async (query: string) => {
    if (!query.trim() || !map) return;
    
    setIsSearching(true);
    try {
      const response = await commuteService.searchPlaces(query);
      setSearchResults(response.results || []);
      
      // Clear existing search markers
      if ((window as any).searchMarkers) {
        (window as any).searchMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      }
      
      // Add markers for search results
      const markers: any[] = [];
      response.results?.forEach((place: any) => {
        const marker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
          position: { lat: place.geometry.location.lat, lng: place.geometry.location.lng },
          map: map,
          title: place.name,
          icon: {
            url: 'https://maps.google.com/mapfiles/ms/icons/blue-dot.png'
          }
        });
        
        // Add click listener to select place
        marker.addListener('click', () => {
          selectPlace(place);
        });
        
        markers.push(marker);
      });
      
      (window as any).searchMarkers = markers;
      
      // Fit map to show all results
      if (response.results && response.results.length > 0) {
        const bounds = new (window as any).google.maps.LatLngBounds();
        response.results.forEach((place: any) => {
          bounds.extend({ lat: place.geometry.location.lat, lng: place.geometry.location.lng });
        });
        map.fitBounds(bounds);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error searching places:', error);
      setError('搜尋地點時發生錯誤');
    } finally {
      setIsSearching(false);
    }
  };

  const selectPlace = (place: any) => {
    if (searchField === 'start') {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, startAddress: place.formatted_address }));
    } else if (searchField === 'end') {
      setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, endAddress: place.formatted_address }));
    }
    
    // Clear search results and markers
    setSearchResults([]);
    setSearchQuery('');
    setSearchField(null);
    
    if ((window as any).searchMarkers) {
      (window as any).searchMarkers.forEach((marker: any) => marker.setMap(null));
      (window as any).searchMarkers = [];
    }
  };

  const formatDuration = (seconds: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!seconds || isNaN(seconds)) return '計算中...';
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    if (hours > 0) {
      return `${hours}小時${minutes}分鐘`;
    }
    return `${minutes}分鐘`;
  };

  const formatDistance = (meters: number | undefined | null) => {
    if (!meters || isNaN(meters)) return '計算中...';
    if (meters >= 1000) {
      return `${(meters / 1000).toFixed(1)}公里`;
    }
    return `${meters}公尺`;
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <Box display="flex" justifyContent="center" alignItems="center" minHeight="400px">
        <CircularProgress />
      </Box>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Box sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
      <Typography variant="h4" gutterBottom>
        我的通勤路線
      </Typography>
      
      {error && (
        <Alert severity="error" sx={{ mb: 2 }} onClose={() => setError('')}>
          {error}
        </Alert>
      )}

      <Box sx={{ 
        display: 'flex', 
        gap: 3, 
        flexDirection: { xs: 'column', md: 'row' },
        flex: 1,
        minHeight: 0 // Allow flex item to shrink
      }}>
        {/* Routes List */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: { xs: '1 1 auto', md: '0 0 400px' },
          minWidth: { md: '400px' },
          maxWidth: { md: '400px' }
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
              <Box display="flex" justifyContent="space-between" alignItems="center" mb={2}>
                <Typography variant="h6">路線列表</Typography>
                <Box display="flex" gap={1}>
                  <Button
                    variant="outlined"
                    size="small"
                    onClick={clearMapOverlays}
                    disabled={!isMapLoaded}
                  >
                    清除地圖
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="contained"
                    startIcon={<AddIcon />}
                    onClick={() => setOpenDialog(true)}
                  >
                    新增路線
                  </Button>
                </Box>
              </Box>
              
              <List>
                {routes.map((route) => (
                  <ListItem key={route.id} onClick={() => handleRouteClick(route)}>
                    <ListItemText
                      primary={route.name}
                      secondary={
                        <Box>
                          <Box sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', fontSize: '0.875rem', mb: 1 }}>
                            {route.start_address} → {route.end_address}
                          </Box>
                          <Box display="flex" gap={1} flexWrap="wrap">
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDuration(route.duration_seconds)}
                              size="small"
                              color="primary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={formatDistance(route.distance_meters)}
                              size="small"
                              color="secondary"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                            <Chip
                              label={route.transport_mode}
                              size="small"
                              variant="outlined"
                            />
                          </Box>
                        </Box>
                      }
                    />
                    <ListItemSecondaryAction>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleToggleFavorite(route);
                        }}
                      >
                        {route.is_favorite ? <StarIcon color="warning" /> : <StarBorderIcon />}
                      </IconButton>
                      <IconButton
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDeleteRoute(route.id);
                        }}
                      >
                        <DeleteIcon />
                      </IconButton>
                    </ListItemSecondaryAction>
                  </ListItem>
                ))}
              </List>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>

        {/* Map */}
        <Box sx={{ 
          flex: '1 1 auto',
          minWidth: 0, // Allow flex item to shrink below content size
          display: 'flex',
          flexDirection: 'column'
        }}>
          <Card sx={{ position: 'relative', height: '100%', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column' }}>
            <CardContent sx={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', p: 0 }}>
              <Typography variant="h6" sx={{ p: 2, pb: 1 }}>
                地圖
              </Typography>
              <Box
                ref={mapRef}
                sx={{
                  flex: 1,
                  width: '100%',
                  borderRadius: 1,
                  border: '1px solid #e0e0e0',
                  backgroundColor: '#f5f5f5',
                  minHeight: '400px',
                }}
              />
              {!isMapLoaded && (
                <Box
                  sx={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: '50%',
                    left: '50%',
                    transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    padding: 2,
                    borderRadius: 1,
                    zIndex: 1000,
                  }}
                >
                  <Typography variant="body2" color="text.secondary">
                    載入地圖中...
                  </Typography>
                </Box>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </Box>
      </Box>

      {/* Create Route Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={openDialog} onClose={() => setOpenDialog(false)} maxWidth="sm" fullWidth>
        <DialogTitle>新增通勤路線</DialogTitle>
        <DialogContent>
          <TextField
            autoFocus
            margin="dense"
            label="路線名稱"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            value={formData.name}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, name: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="描述（選填）"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            multiline
            rows={2}
            value={formData.description}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, description: e.target.value })}
            sx={{ mb: 2 }}
          />
          {/* Start Address with Search */}
          <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            <TextField
              margin="dense"
              label="起點地址"
              fullWidth
              variant="outlined"
              value={formData.startAddress}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, startAddress: e.target.value })}
              InputProps={{
                endAdornment: (
                  <InputAdornment position="end">
                    <IconButton
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSearchField('start');
                        setSearchQuery(formData.startAddress);
                        if (formData.startAddress.trim()) {
                          searchPlaces(formData.startAddress);
                        }
                      }}
                      edge="end"
                    >
                      <SearchIcon />
                    </IconButton>
                  </InputAdornment>
                ),
              }}
            />
            {searchField === 'start' && (
              <Box sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                <TextField
                  size="small"
                  placeholder="搜尋地點..."
                  fullWidth
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyPress={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      searchPlaces(searchQuery);
                    }
                  }}
                  InputProps={{
                    endAdornment: (
                      <InputAdornment position="end">
                        <IconButton
                          onClick={() => searchPlaces(searchQuery)}
                          disabled={isSearching}
                          edge="end"
                        >
                          {isSearching ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SearchIcon />}
                        </IconButton>
                      </InputAdornment>
                    ),
                  }}
                />
                {searchResults.length > 0 && (
                  <List dense sx={{ maxHeight: 200, overflow: 'auto', border: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mt: 1 }}>
                    {searchResults.map((place, index) => (
                      <ListItem
                        key={index}
                        button
                        onClick={() => {
                          setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, startAddress: place.formatted_address }));
                          setSearchResults([]);
                          setSearchField(null);
                        }}
                      >
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={place.name}
                          secondary={place.formatted_address}
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>

          {/* End Address with Search */}
          <Box sx={{ mb: 2 }}>
            <TextField
              margin="dense"
              label="終點地址"
              fullWidth
              variant="outlined"
              value={formData.endAddress}
              onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, endAddress: e.target.value })}
              InputProps={{
                endAdornment: (
                  <InputAdornment position="end">
                    <IconButton
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSearchField('end');
                        setSearchQuery(formData.endAddress);
                        if (formData.endAddress.trim()) {
                          searchPlaces(formData.endAddress);
                        }
                      }}
                      edge="end"
                    >
                      <SearchIcon />
                    </IconButton>
                  </InputAdornment>
                ),
              }}
            />
            {searchField === 'end' && (
              <Box sx={{ mt: 1 }}>
                <TextField
                  size="small"
                  placeholder="搜尋地點..."
                  fullWidth
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyPress={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      searchPlaces(searchQuery);
                    }
                  }}
                  InputProps={{
                    endAdornment: (
                      <InputAdornment position="end">
                        <IconButton
                          onClick={() => searchPlaces(searchQuery)}
                          disabled={isSearching}
                          edge="end"
                        >
                          {isSearching ? <CircularProgress size={20} /> : <SearchIcon />}
                        </IconButton>
                      </InputAdornment>
                    ),
                  }}
                />
                {searchResults.length > 0 && (
                  <List dense sx={{ maxHeight: 200, overflow: 'auto', border: 1, borderColor: 'divider', mt: 1 }}>
                    {searchResults.map((place, index) => (
                      <ListItem
                        key={index}
                        button
                        onClick={() => {
                          setFormData(prev => ({ ...prev, endAddress: place.formatted_address }));
                          setSearchResults([]);
                          setSearchField(null);
                        }}
                      >
                        <ListItemText
                          primary={place.name}
                          secondary={place.formatted_address}
                        />
                      </ListItem>
                    ))}
                  </List>
                )}
              </Box>
            )}
          </Box>
          <TextField
            margin="dense"
            label="交通方式"
            fullWidth
            variant="outlined"
            select
            SelectProps={{ native: true }}
            value={formData.transportMode}
            onChange={(e) => setFormData({ ...formData, transportMode: e.target.value })}
          >
            <option value="driving">開車</option>
            <option value="walking">步行</option>
            <option value="bicycling">騎自行車</option>
            <option value="transit">大眾運輸</option>
          </TextField>
        </DialogContent>
        <DialogActions>
          <Button onClick={() => setOpenDialog(false)}>取消</Button>
          <Button
            onClick={handleCreateRoute}
            variant="contained"
            disabled={!formData.name || !formData.startAddress || !formData.endAddress}
          >
            建立路線
          </Button>
        </DialogActions>
      </Dialog>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default Dashboard;

      const startMarker = new (window as any).google.maps.Marker({
